name: The Venetian lagoon
title: Distributed Algorithms of the Venetian Lagoon
people: the merchants, part-time councillors, sea captains and scribes of a town in the Venetian lagoon

hero.alt: A town on low islands in a teal lagoon, seen from above: a domed basilica and its bell tower, a paved square, palazzi, workshops and a salt works, joined by quays and bridges over narrow canals.
hero.caption: The town of Rivoalto. Nobody here shares a room. Every message in every scene walks one of these quays.
